empty.title: No instances yet
empty.body: Point the app at a ComfyUI folder you already have, or unpack a fresh build from an archive.

add.title: Add an instance
add.lead: Choose the folder of a portable ComfyUI build. Nothing inside it will be changed.

field.name: Name
field.portHint: Used at startup when it is free.
field.profilesNone: No .bat launchers found — you will need to set the launch options by hand.

unavailable.title: The folder is gone
unavailable.body: The build is no longer at {path}. It may have been moved, renamed, or the drive is not connected. The instance stays on the list until you remove it.

remove.title: Remove {name} from the list?
remove.body: Only the entry in this app goes away. The folder on disk, its models and its settings stay exactly where they are.

install.title: Install
install.lead: Two ways in: point the app at an existing ComfyUI folder, or unpack a portable build from a .7z archive into one or several destinations.

existing.title: I already have a folder
existing.body: Register a build that is already unpacked. The folder is left untouched.

wizard.title: Unpack from an archive
wizard.body: Unpack a portable build into one or several destinations and register them at once.

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.lead: Keep the workflows you actually use in one place, tag them, and add them to any instance.

appearance.title: Appearance

preview.title: Preview
preview.hint: Numbers, dates and word forms follow the selected language.

appearance.comfyNote: ComfyUI keeps its own theme and language inside the embedded tab, and the app does not change them.

paths.title: Where the app keeps its data

uninstall.title: What uninstalling removes
uninstall.body: Uninstalling removes the app and its own settings. Your models, shared templates and ComfyUI folders stay where they are.
